text:
The plate is a square plate of roughly 22-24 cm. It holds two corn cob pieces, each about 5-6 cm across and 3-4 cm long, and a small spinach salad with a few cherry tomatoes and some shredded carrot.

Corn pieces: each is about 60-70 g, so about 130 g together. At roughly 0.9 kcal/g for corn on the cob, that is about 115 kcal.

Salad: about 40 g of spinach, 2 tomatoes at about 30 g, and a little carrot. That is roughly 75 g and 20 kcal. There is no visible dressing.

Total: about 205 g and 135 kcal.
